stories.h: Likud and Yashar open marathon unity talks; Bennett rejects Netanyahu
stories.s: Eisenkot's Yashar began extended coalition talks with Likud on Sunday, saying he won't drag them out. Bennett reaffirmed backing an Eisenkot-led unity government and ruled out joining Netanyahu or his bloc.

stories.h: Settlers torch homes and cars near Ramallah; Eisenkot cites Jewish terror
stories.s: Overnight raids on three villages near Ramallah burned about a dozen vehicles and several homes, with no injuries. Eisenkot blamed Ben Gvir and Smotrich and urged administrative detention; police opened investigations, no arrests reported.

stories.h: Lebanon's Aoun demands Israeli pullout as strikes hit the south
stories.s: On the eve of independence day, President Aoun demanded Israel withdraw, halt attacks and free detainees, and told Hezbollah to disarm. Israeli strikes hit Nabatieh, Bint Jbeil and Marjayoun districts the same day.

stories.h: Boy, 13, shot dead outside school in East Jerusalem
stories.s: A 13-year-old was shot at close range near a school in Shuafat camp; police suspect a criminal feud, possibly mistaken identity. Hours earlier a woman died in a Tira car bombing; 209 Arab citizens killed this year.

stories.h: Haredi protesters block Jerusalem light rail
stories.s: Ultra-Orthodox demonstrators blocked the Jerusalem light rail on Sunday afternoon, and police said officers were preparing to disperse them. The story was still developing.
